title: AWS cost review for October
body:
Hi,

Our AWS bill for October came in at $18,400, up 22% from September. The main drivers:

- Telemetry pipeline storage (+$2,100)
- Unused staging instances left running (+$900)

Action items: set lifecycle rules on the telemetry bucket and shut down idle staging environments. Changes go in the infra-terraform repo.

Thanks,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
